Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 42589 of 2023

Applicant :- Rahul Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mukesh Joshi,Sanjay Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2.  The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 09 of 2022,
under Sections 419, 420 of IPC and Section 66-D of Information Technology Act, Police Station Cyber Crime, District Moradabad with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

entities.text: Police Station Cyber Crime, District Moradabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is submitted that applicant is not named in the FIR.
During investigation it was found that Rs.1 lakh has been transferred to the account of applicant by co-accused Amarjeet.
Only mistake committed by applicant is the he never enquired from the Bank about the source of aforesaid transaction and withdrew the amount.
It is submitted that applicant is ready to pay the amount of Rs. 1 lakh to the informant.

It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 05.08.2023 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

sentences.text: Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and argued that investigation of the matter is being conducted by the Cyber Cell.
Total Rs.32 lakh is transferred to the account of co-accused Amarjeet, out of which amount of Rs.1 lakh was transferred to the account of applicant.

5. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicantRahul Kumar involved in the aforesaid case crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). It is directed that applicant shall be released only after he deposits Rs.1 lakh through demand draft before the court concerned which is to be paid to informant,
subject to final outcome of the trial.
Trial court shall be at liberty to take a personal bond along with one surety of the informant as security of that amount.
(2) The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(3). The applicant will not influence any witness.
(4). The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(5). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
7.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.

Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Mohit  Rahul Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160900883/
